adds.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
adds.text: Logan wakes in a changed future and finds Scott alive at the school. Scott warns him off Jean, and Logan tells him it's good to see him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Alive again in the changed future. Warns Logan off Jean.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tells Scott it's good to see him, to Scott's confusion.
adds.evidence: In the revised 2023 at the X-Mansion, Cyclops warns Wolverine not to flirt with Jean; Wolverine says it's good to see him and Scott answers 'Uh-huh'. Kind kept ally, matching their last stage.

adds.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
adds.text: Storm arrives at the temple with Logan and fights the Sentinels to protect the X-Men while his mind is in the past, and she is killed there.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Holds off the Sentinels while Logan's mind is in the past.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Arrives at the temple with Storm, then goes back to 1973.
adds.evidence: 2023: the survivors at the Chinese temple are joined by Storm, Logan, Magneto and Xavier; in the last stand Storm is among those killed while Logan's mind is in 1973. Xavier, not Storm, leads here, so ally rather than boss.

adds.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
adds.text: Bobby is among the last X-Men who hold off the Sentinels at the temple while Logan's mind is in the past, and he is killed there.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: One of the last X-Men defending the temple.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Man whose trip to 1973 Bobby fights to protect.
adds.evidence: 2023: Iceman is among the survivors at the temple Logan joins; in the last stand the mutants buy time while Kitty keeps Logan's mind in 1973, and Iceman is killed.

adds.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
adds.text: Colossus is among the last X-Men who hold off the Sentinels at the temple while Logan's mind is in the past, and he is killed there.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: One of the last X-Men defending the temple.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Man whose trip to 1973 Colossus fights to protect.
adds.evidence: 2023: Colossus is among the survivors at the temple Logan joins; in the last stand the mutants buy time while Logan's mind is in 1973, and Colossus is killed.

adds.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
adds.text: In 1973 Logan finds Hank looking after the closed school, and Hank joins his mission to stop Raven, from Erik's breakout to Paris and Washington.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Joins Logan's 1973 mission to stop Raven.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A stranger from the future whose mission Hank joins.
adds.evidence: Awakening in 1973, Logan goes to the X-Mansion and learns from Hank McCoy that the school has closed; Hank, Xavier and Logan foil Mystique in Paris and travel to Washington together.

adds.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
adds.text: Storm arrives at the temple with Xavier and dies holding off the Sentinels while he helps keep Logan's mind in the past.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Dies defending the temple during Xavier's plan.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The mentor whose last plan Storm fights for.
adds.evidence: 2023: Storm, Logan, Magneto and Xavier join the survivors at the temple; Storm is killed in the Sentinel attack while Xavier's plan plays out.

adds.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
adds.text: In 1973 Hank looks after the broken Charles at the closed school and makes the serum that lets him walk, then helps him find Raven.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Looks after Charles and makes his serum.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The broken friend Hank looks after in 1973.
adds.evidence: 1973: a broken Xavier at the closed X-Mansion uses a serum that lets him walk; Hank stays with him and goes with him and Logan to Paris and Washington.

adds.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
adds.text: Hank helps free Erik from the Pentagon, but in Paris he fights Erik to stop him from killing Raven.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fights Erik in Paris to save Raven.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Freed from the Pentagon, then fought by Hank in Paris.
adds.evidence: 1973: the group breaks Magneto out of the Pentagon; in Paris Magneto attempts to kill Mystique and McCoy fights him, allowing her to escape.

adds.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
adds.text: Bobby fights the Sentinels in Moscow to buy Kitty time, and later dies defending the temple while she keeps Logan's mind in the past.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fights to buy Kitty time in Moscow and at the temple.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Bobby fights to protect.
adds.evidence: 2023 Moscow: the mutants sacrifice themselves to buy Kitty time to send Bishop back; at the temple Iceman is killed while Kitty holds Logan in 1973. The Rogue Cut adds that they are dating, not in the theatrical cut.

owner_calls.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
owner_calls.question: Should The Rogue Cut count as on screen? In it Xavier, Magneto and Bobby rescue Rogue from Cerebro and she takes over holding Logan's mind (he senses her). The theatrical cut gives her a wordless three-second cameo only.
options: Count The Rogue Cut: add stages for Rogue with Logan, Xavier and Magneto
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia 'The Rogue Cut' section and xmenmovies fandom 'Rogue Cut' plot.
